description: This source file implements proxy bypass rules logic for network proxy resolution, including platform-specific implicit rules, hostname and IP address checks, and rule parsing and evaluation.

classes.name: BypassSimpleHostnamesRule
classes.description: Rule that matches hostnames with no dots and not IP addresses, used for bypassing simple hostnames.

classes.name: SubtractImplicitBypassesRule
classes.description: Rule that matches implicit bypass rules such as localhost and loopback addresses.

methods.name: IsLinkLocalIP
methods.description: Checks if a URL's host is a link-local IP address.

methods.name: IsIPv4MappedLoopback
methods.description: Checks if a URL's host is an IPv6 address mapped to IPv4 loopback.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether a URL matches the rule criteria.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the rule.

methods.name: ParseRule
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a rule object.
